CALORIES.title: Calories
CALORIES.text: You log meals from the food database, recipes or a quick entry. The app adds up energy, protein, carbs, fat, fibre and sodium and shows them against your daily targets.

PORTIONS.title: Portions
PORTIONS.text: Instead of weighing you count hand portions: palms of protein, cupped hands of carbs, fists of vegetables and thumbs of fats. The target is a number of portions a day.

GUIDANCE.title: Guidance
GUIDANCE.text: No counting: for each meal of your plan you mark whether you followed it – yes, partly or no.

client.lead: How to use the app and what you see in it.

using.title: Using the app
using.text:
Today – your day at a glance: targets, training, fluids, your competition and what your coach expects from you.
Nutrition – logging in your mode; the arrows switch days.
Messages – your conversation with your coach.
More – nutrition plan, recipes, hydration, progress, supplements, calendar, check-in, profile and settings.

modes.title: Tracking modes
modes.text: Your coach sets one of three modes. If it changes, what you logged before stays saved.

checkIns.title: How check-ins work
checkIns.text: Once a week, on the day your coach sets, you fill in a short check-in: how you feel on a 1–10 scale and any questions. The bell and your home screen remind you. Your coach reviews it and writes feedback, which you find in the check-in and on your home screen.

contact.title: Contacting your coach
contact.text: Write in Messages. You can comment on a particular nutrition day or check-in right there – your coach sees it in the conversation too. You can delete your own message within 5 minutes.

coach.lead: How to work with your clients in the app.

using.title: Using the app
using.text:
Overview – who needs attention, check-ins to review, messages, calls and competitions.
Clients – the list with filters; per client the nutrition plan, training, competitions, progress, check-ins, supplements, messages and notes.
Calendar – every client's sessions, competitions, calls and check-in days.
Library – foods, recipes, fueling and timeline templates.

modes.title: Tracking modes
modes.text: Switch a client's mode in their header (Change tracking). The data of the other modes stays saved.

checkIns.title: Check-ins
checkIns.text: Set the check-in day on the client's overview. Sent check-ins wait under Check-ins, oldest first. The detail shows the answers with their trend, the week's context and your notes; publish your feedback and the client is notified.

contact.title: Talking to clients
contact.text: Each client has one conversation with you. Unread messages show under Messages, in the client list and on your overview. Comment on a nutrition day or check-in right there. Schedule a call from the client's header.
